title: Harmonic tokens and rollout patterns for Console: a unified design system pass
creator: Aisha Bergman
description:
Background: The Redwood Console has accumulated component variants and ad-hoc tokens across Dashboard, Rollouts and Cost views. Fragmentation causes inconsistent spacing, button emphasis, and berry/teal color usage between feature pages, which increases dev integration work and causes perceptible visual regressions in user studies.

Goal: Create a single source of truth Figma library and token set (color, type, spacing, elevation, radius, iconography scale) plus a pattern catalog for rollout cards, cost table rows, and metric cards. Produce a lightweight migration guide for engineers and a small batch of updated prototypes for validation in the next release.

Scope:
- Define semantic tokens and migration mapping from existing variables (console-v1) -> (harmonic-ds).
- Audit and converge component variants for: Button, Primary/Secondary/Link, Toggle, Select, TableRow, MetricCard, RolloutRow, Banner, EmptyState.
- Establish spacing system (4pt baseline) and responsive token rules for small/medium/large panes.
- Create Figma library with component instances + documentation frames for handoff.
- Run 2 consistency reviews (PMs + Eng on March 8, 10) and a quick usability pass with 3 engineers on interactive prototypes.

Trade-offs and constraints:
- Keep existing public API of console CSS classes where possible; prefer token shims over immediate class rename to reduce rollout friction.
- Some older embedded dashboards rely on current color stop; scheduled to be migrated over two sprints to avoid regressions.

Deliverables:
- harmonic-ds Figma file (production library)
- Migration mapping spreadsheet + README for engineers
- Updated prototypes for Dashboards, Rollouts, and Cost views (high-fidelity interactive)
- PR template for component updates and a checklist for visual regression tests

Acceptance criteria:
- Figma library exported and versioned; tokens exported to JSON and synced with design-ops repo.
- Engineers can toggle tokens via a feature flag and observe no visual regressions in 90% of key routes per automated visual diff.
- PM sign-off on rollout patterns and cost row density options.
- Two design-system consistency review meetings logged with action items tracked.
acceptance_criteria: Figma harmonic-ds library published with tokens and components
Token JSON exported and attached to design-ops repo with schema version
Migration README with class-to-token mapping and 3-step roll-out plan
Engineers confirm prototype integration with a single tokens toggle in staging
Two consistency reviews completed and follow-ups tracked in sub_issues
